text:
emily-support: FYI ticket from AcmePayments — invoice for Feb shows ~1.2M tokens but their dashboard (per-route) shows ~820k. They believe it spikes align with a mobile client that does aggressive reconnects during poor cellular. Can eng take a look?
raj-eng-sre: grabbing logs now. Do we have the request-ids/example session ids from the customer?
emily-support: pasted what they sent: 
```
client_id=acme_payments_42
session=mobile-7f3a
events:
  2026-02-10T18:02:11Z SSE_CLOSE reason=client_disconnect req=R-1001
  2026-02-10T18:02:12Z SSE_OPEN req=R-1002 parent_req=R-1001
  2026-02-10T18:02:12Z STREAM_CHUNK tokens=512 req=R-1002
  2026-02-10T18:02:13Z SSE_CLOSE reason=client_cancel req=R-1002
  2026-02-10T18:02:13Z SSE_OPEN req=R-1003 parent_req=R-1002
  2026-02-10T18:02:13Z STREAM_CHUNK tokens=489 req=R-1003
  ...
```
They say the client resends the same prompt on reconnect.
acme_ops: adding context — our SDK previously retried transparently on network flaps; we only started seeing invoice > dashboard after last billing month. We do send identical prompt on reconnect, we expect dedupe.
raj-eng-sre: thanks. Hypothesis: the metering pipeline is counting token emissions per stream chunk event (emit-on-chunk), while the billing dedupe for retries only considers top-level request_id. If reconnects create new request_ids (R-1002, R-1003) the pipeline treats them as separate.
marco-runtime: jumping in — runtime historically emits two metering events: (1) tentative emit per chunk for near-real-time usage, (2) finalized emit on stream completion. We added tentative emit to support live dashboards. If a client cancels and reconnects, tentative emits may not be rolled back, and finalized emits can still be produced for the subsequent request leading to double count.
lena-billing: invoice pipeline uses the raw finalized events aggregated by billing-collector. Dashboards use the live tentative metrics with a fast-path aggregator that attempts dedupe by request_id but not by parent-child session chain. So either path could diverge depending on which events made it through.
raj-eng-sre: can we get a single repro from support? Ideally a minimal Node script that simulates cancel+reconnect with identical prompt so runtime produces both tentative + finalize events.
emily-support: customer attached a quick repro, pasted here: 
```
// pseudo-node SSE client
const s = openSSE('/v1/chat?stream=true&client_id=acme');
s.on('message', m => {
  if (m.chunk_id == 2) s.close(); // simulate mid-gen cancel
});
// immediately reopen
openSSE('/v1/chat?stream=true&client_id=acme');
```
acme_ops: correct — that's essentially our mobile wrapper behavior (close then immediate reconnect).
marco-runtime: thanks. Quick debugging note: look at metering logs for req=R-1002 and R-1003. We should inspect emit_type fields: tentative|finalize and the meter_key used (we attach request_id currently). If tentative events are emitted with parent_req and not rolled back, they persist. I can instrument a small fix: annotate tentative emits with a temporary ledger id and mark them as 'pending' until finalize; pending that get dropped on cancellation.
lena-billing: operationally, even if runtime fixes it, we may need to reconcile invoices for the affected month. Can you produce a list of affected request_ids and token deltas so we can credit if confirmed?
raj-eng-sre: I'm running a reconcile job now to compare finalized vs dashboard tentative totals for acme_payments_42 between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-28. Will output CSV of per-session deltas.
emily-support: customer asks for ETA — can we commit to a window?
marco-runtime: quick patch to gate tentative emit on a 'should_emit_tentative' flag that the SDK sets when it expects retries. But that requires SDK change; shorter path: runtime will stop generating duplicate finalize on reconnect when parent_req matches and last_chunk_id < total — i.e., treat reconnect with parent_req as continuation instead of new finalization. I'll push a PR and add a toggle on staging.
raj-eng-sre: reconcile job run started. If anyone needs sample log queries: 
```
select t.request_id, t.parent_req, t.emit_type, sum(t.tokens) as tokens
from metering_raw t
where t.client_id='acme_payments_42' and t.ts between '2026-02-01' and '2026-02-28'
group by t.request_id, t.parent_req, t.emit_type;
```
lena-billing: thanks. If the reconcile shows >5% over invoice vs dashboard difference attributable to duplicate finalizes we'll prepare a credit. Need final numbers by EOD PT.
emily-support: pinging acme_ops — we'll follow up with a timeline and potentially a credit. Any chance you can provide a few full request_ids for the highest-impact days?
acme_ops: sending three full request ids in DM now. Appreciate quick triage. Let us know if you need SDK flags. :pray:
deploy-bot: staging rollout of runtime tentative-emit-toggle started for canary host rtx-12.
marco-runtime: I'll follow up with the PR link and a short changelog. If reconciler confirms duplicates, plan: (1) retroactive credit, (2) runtime patch to avoid double-finalize, (3) add dedupe key that joins parent_req chains in billing-collector.
raj-eng-sre: reconcile finished — preliminary: dashboard (tentative) shows 819,432 tokens, billing finalized shows 1,195,871. Delta ~376,439. Filtering for sessions with parent_req chain shows ~260k attributable to reconnect-chains. Dropping logs into ticket.
lena-billing: filing credit request for 260,439 tokens equivalent. Emily, please confirm customer acceptance and mark ticket for billing adjustment.
emily-support: will confirm with acme_ops and update thread. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
